decisions.decision: Swap Phases 3 and 4 by renumbering (Option B)
decisions.rationale: User sees Join/Cursor/Demo as the conclusion and Timeline Integration as the feature; rehearsal should test final code. demo-safe tag is the fallback

decisions.decision: Keep the 1 s scan for edit detection; events only optional triggers
decisions.rationale: onActiveSequenceStructureChanged never fires; onActiveSequenceChanged fires for every edit but carries no detail

decisions.decision: Timing op = {start, end, inPoint} in ticks; outPoint set to in + length
decisions.rationale: Probes: picture comes only from start/end/inPoint; outPoint does not affect playback; start setter is a no-op; move() does not snap to frames

decisions.decision: Validate every move/trim before apply (in >= 0, in + length <= media, no overlap with neighbours)
decisions.rationale: Premiere accepts in > out, clips past media (black frames) and overlapping clips with no error

decisions.decision: Do not sync added clips by nodeId
decisions.rationale: nodeId is stored in .prproj, but new clips on each laptop come from the same counter and can collide
